isolation_defense_layers.two_workspace_architecture: Enforced. Agent workspaces receive solely the target buggy file and node.py (if graph task). Tests and JSON oracles remain strictly in the benchmark root.
isolation_defense_layers.fail_closed_creation_gate: Operational. Any detection of test_*, *_test.py, .json, or correct* files immediately wipes the directory and raises RuntimeError.
isolation_defense_layers.isolated_evaluator_runner: Operational. Pytest runs with isolated temp cwd, candidate workspace at sys.path[0], and --import-mode=append, resolving candidate code over upstream/reference code.
isolation_defense_layers.evaluator_output_sanitizer: Operational. Strips test parametrization inputs/outputs, variable dumps, and assertion values (replacing with [ORACLE_REDACTED]). Redacts diff lines.
isolation_defense_layers.patch_security_gate: Operational. Inspects patch target files and AST/tokens, failing closed if open(), subprocess, os.system, or external modifications are attempted.
isolation_defense_layers.context_builder_containment: Operational. Canonical workspace containment check fpath.resolve().is_relative_to(workspace.resolve()) blocks ../ traversals, absolute paths, and external symlinks.
isolation_defense_layers.agent_permissions_boundary: Operational. DDIV model-facing agents (Coder, Locator, Tester, Supervisor) are pure JSON-in/JSON-out LLM wrappers with zero shell or file-read tools.
